Owner and founder

Wade LeBeau

After decades in construction and roofing, Wade started War Horse Roofing in Fort Washakie. He runs the company and takes calls from building owners across Wyoming.

Wade also wants to help veterans start businesses of their own. That goal is part of what he set out to build at War Horse.
